title: Removal of the Transformer Rectifier Unit and Disconnection of the Direct Current Feeder
abstract: Removal of one transformer rectifier unit and disconnection of its direct current feeder, including the isolation sequence that guarantees the terminal is dead and the recording of the feeder lug condition.

sections.purpose: This task removes one transformer rectifier unit from its rack and disconnects the direct current feeder, leaving the installation safe and recording the condition of the terminal lugs.
sections.job_setup_note: The unit output terminal remains live from the battery bus even with external power removed, so the isolation sequence must be followed exactly and the terminal proved dead with a meter. The unit is heavy for its size and the rack has no retention once the front clamp is released. Terminal lugs must be inspected and photographed before removal because heat damage there is the main reason for unscheduled removal.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove external power and shut down the auxiliary power unit. 2. Isolate the battery and confirm the direct current bus is dead with a meter at the terminal. WARNING: THE UNIT OUTPUT TERMINAL REMAINS LIVE FROM THE BATTERY BUS AFTER EXTERNAL POWER IS REMOVED. PROVE THE TERMINAL DEAD BEFORE YOU TOUCH IT. 3. Get access to the rack in zones 274 and 244. 4. Photograph the terminal lugs in position and record any discolouration. 5. Disconnect the feeder from the terminal and insulate the free end. 6. Disconnect the harness D2430112027785 and the upper cable assembly D2430112037168 at the unit connector and cap them. 7. Release the front clamp and support the unit before it moves. CAUTION: THE RACK HAS NO RETENTION ONCE THE FRONT CLAMP IS RELEASED. SUPPORT THE UNIT BEFORE YOU OPEN THE CLAMP. 8. Withdraw the unit and put it on the trolley. 9. Inspect the backshell D2430118219105 and the bolts AGS708559-04 for heat damage and record the finding. 10. Check the contactor of FIN 7GX and the harness of FIN 28PC for discolouration. 11. Cap the rack connectors and fit the terminal cover.
sections.close_out: Fit the terminal cover and confirm that no conductor is exposed. Record the unit serial number, the hours since installation, the lug condition and any discolouration on the component removal card. Leave the battery isolated and the warning notices in place until the replacement unit is installed.

safety_precautions: Prove the output terminal dead with a meter before you touch it.
Isolate the battery and put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
Support the unit before you release the front clamp.
Insulate the free end of the feeder immediately.
